sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Abhishek Singh
Hon'ble Rahul Chaturvedi,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for petitioners and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. By means of the present writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioner is assailing the legality and validity of FIR dated 29.07.2023, registered as Case Crime No.0205 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 506, 504 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act , P.S.-Shahganj, Jaunpur District Jaunpur.

3. Learned AGA submits that the charge-sheet against the petitioners has been filed on 16.08.2023,
as such, the writ petition has become infructuous and may be dismissed as infructuous.
